summary: Frontend-only regression of the new fixture 'round' display (plus API confirmation via Bearer token). Verified: (1) /api/scanner returns a real 'round' per row (Round 1..Round 23, none 'Upcoming' in sample of 465); (2) /api/leagues/eng-nl/matchups next_fixture.round = 'Round 1' and /api/leagues/bra-sa/matchups = 'Round 22'; (3) Scanner table renders data-testid='scanner-row-round' on all 465 rows with values like Round 1/2/10/21/23 and never the literal 'Upcoming'; (4) Top Mismatches table Fixture cells append the round after the date (e.g. 'vs Telstar - Aug 8 - Round 1', 'vs Mirassol - Aug 9 - Round 22'); (5) Dashboard league switcher to National League shows 'Round 1' on all 24 matchup rows, Brazil Serie A shows 'Round 22' on all 20 rows; (6) Fixture detail header shows data-testid='fixture-round' = 'Round 1' next to the kickoff datetime. Auth via session_token=qa-test-token-123 cookie worked; no console errors. POST refresh was NOT triggered.
